title: Kafeda buyurtma berish
can_do: Kafeda odobli tarzda buyurtma bera olasiz va hisobni so'raysiz
why: «I want coffee» grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin qo'pol eshitiladi. Bitta ibora — I'd like — sizni odobli mijozga aylantiradi.

points.text: I would like — «xohlayman» ning odobli shakli. Deyarli har doim qisqartiriladi: I'd like. Bu I want dan ancha yumshoqroq eshitiladi.
I'd like dan keyin ot yoki to + fe'l keladi: I'd like a sandwich. I'd like to see the menu.
Savol shakli — Would you like ...? Bu taklif qilish uchun ishlatiladi va javobda «Yes, please» yoki «No, thank you» deyiladi.

examples.en: 'Would you like anything else?' 'No, thank you.'

points.text: Kafedagi tayyor iboralar: Can I have the menu? — menyu bering; The bill, please — hisob; Is service included? — xizmat haqi kirganmi?

examples.en: Can I have the bill, please?

head: Vaziyat
Ibora
rows: Can I have the menu, please?

common_errors.why: Grammatik to'g'ri, lekin buyruq kabi eshitiladi. Xizmat joyida I'd like ishlatiladi.
To faqat fe'l oldidan qo'yiladi, ot oldidan emas.

common_errors.right: I'd like to drink tea. / I'd like some tea.

common_errors.wrong: 'Would you like a dessert?' 'Yes, I would like.'
common_errors.why: Taklifga qisqa va odobli javob — Yes, please.

common_errors.right: Can I have the bill, please?
common_errors.why: Buyruq shakli qo'pol. Iltimos qolipini ishlating.

items.focus: to qo'yish kerakmi yoki yo'qligini aniqlash
«I'd like to a coffee», «Bring me the bill» xatolarini topish

final.task: Kafega kirdingiz. Ofitsiant bilan to'liq suhbatni yozing: stol, menyu, buyurtma, hisob. 6-8 gap.

skill_task.task: Kafeda buyurtma berilmoqda. Nima buyurtma qilinganini va hisob qanchaligini yozing.
